item.text: {"winner":"B","confidence":"high","summary":"B is meaningfully closer to the frozen contract: it has the exact required Upload signature and directly tests all required behaviors. Both patches improperly add association fields and duplicate Add’s request path, but A introduces substantially more contract-breaking API and retry changes.","reasons":["B declares the exact required API: Upload(ctx context.Context, fileName string, content io.Reader, opts ...FilesOption). A instead uses ...UploadFileOption and introduces new option interfaces, violating the frozen signature and changing FilesOption behavior.","B tests multipart field/name/content, retry with streamed file content, pre-request validation, and source-reader error propagation. A has no visible source-reader failure test.","A changes generic RawClient retry and reader-ownership semantics, RetryPolicy documentation, and Add behavior despite the explicit instruction not to refactor unrelated request/retry machinery.","A adds more duplicate machinery through UploadFileOption, FilesRequestOption, uploadFileOptions, and NewFileWithFields instead of making a focused convenience wrapper."],"risks_a":["Upload does not have the mandated signature.","Changes public option return types and introduces parallel option APIs.","Broad RawClient retry behavior change could affect every reader-backed request and creates concurrency hazards by replaying one shared io.Seeker instance through GetBody closures beyond the requested scope and despite Add needing preserved behavior semantics and no retry refactor requested by contract implies preserving Add existing behavior exactly, generic seeker support changes it materially; also transport closes original? wrapped nop close avoids caller closure but semantic global shift remains significant. It also directly invokes Raw.Do in Upload, duplicating Add response/request code rather than routing through Add as required contract. It adds forbidden association fields and a generic raw form field option. Missing explicit source-reader error test."],"risks_b":["Adds forbidden association fields and extends FilesOption state with multipart form data.","Upload calls Raw.Do and duplicates Add’s request construction, decoding, and error handling instead of routing through FilesService.Add as required.","Extending the internal multipart helper with form-field machinery is unnecessary for the requested single file part."]}
